SELECT accounts.code, accounts.name, accounts.category_id, accounts.parent_id, accounts.posting_role, accounts.is_active, accounts.id, accounts.created_at, accounts.updated_at, accounts.owner_id, account_categories.account_type, coalesce(sum(journal_lines.debit), %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1, coalesce(sum(journal_lines.credit), %(coalesce_4)s::INTEGER) AS coalesce_3 
FROM accounts JOIN account_categories ON account_categories.id = accounts.category_id JOIN journal_lines ON journal_lines.account_id = accounts.id JOIN journal_entries ON journal_entries.id = journal_lines.journal_id 
WHERE accounts.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID AND journal_entries.owner_id = %(owner_id_2)s::UUID AND journal_entries.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND account_categories.account_type IN (%(account_type_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(account_type_1_2)s::VARCHAR) GROUP BY accounts.id, account_categories.account_type ORDER BY accounts.code

SELECT payments.party_id, payments.payment_date, payments.amount, payments.reference, payments.method, payments.sayad_id, payments.customer_credit_account_id, payments.status, payments.journal_id, payments.id, payments.created_at, payments.updated_at, payments.owner_id 
FROM payments 
WHERE payments.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID AND payments.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT bill_payments.party_id, bill_payments.payment_date, bill_payments.amount, bill_payments.reference, bill_payments.method, bill_payments.sayad_id, bill_payments.status, bill_payments.journal_id, bill_payments.id, bill_payments.created_at, bill_payments.updated_at, bill_payments.owner_id 
FROM bill_payments 
WHERE bill_payments.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID AND bill_payments.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT expenses.name, expenses.amount, expenses.payment_date, expenses.method, expenses.tracking_code, expenses.journal_id, expenses.id, expenses.created_at, expenses.updated_at, expenses.owner_id 
FROM expenses 
WHERE expenses.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID

SELECT invoices.invoice_number, invoices.customer_id, invoices.issue_date, invoices.due_date, invoices.status, invoices.payment_method, invoices.subtotal, invoices.tax, invoices.total, invoices.amount_paid, invoices.journal_id, invoices.id, invoices.created_at, invoices.updated_at, invoices.owner_id, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (payments.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND payments.payment_date <= %(payment_date_1)s::DATE) THEN payment_allocations.amount ELSE %(param_1)s::INTEGER END), %(coalesce_1)s::INTEGER) AS paid_as_of 
FROM invoices LEFT OUTER JOIN payment_allocations ON payment_allocations.invoice_id = invoices.id LEFT OUTER JOIN payments ON payments.id = payment_allocations.payment_id 
WHERE invoices.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID AND invoices.issue_date <= %(issue_date_1)s::DATE AND invoices.status IN (%(status_2_1)s::VARCHAR, %(status_2_2)s::VARCHAR, %(status_2_3)s::VARCHAR) GROUP BY invoices.id 
HAVING invoices.total > coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (payments.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND payments.payment_date <= %(payment_date_1)s::DATE) THEN payment_allocations.amount ELSE %(param_1)s::INTEGER END), %(coalesce_1)s::INTEGER) ORDER BY invoices.due_date, invoices.invoice_number

Plans.Filter: (invoices.total > COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN (((payments.status)::text = 'POSTED'::text) AND (payments.payment_date <= '2026-09-10'::date)) THEN payment_allocations.amount ELSE '0'::numeric END), '0'::numeric))

SELECT parties.name AS parties_name, parties.email AS parties_email, parties.phone AS parties_phone, parties.address AS parties_address, parties.is_customer AS parties_is_customer, parties.is_supplier AS parties_is_supplier, parties.is_active AS parties_is_active, parties.id AS parties_id, parties.created_at AS parties_created_at, parties.updated_at AS parties_updated_at, parties.owner_id AS parties_owner_id 
FROM parties 
WHERE parties.id = %(pk_1)s::UUID

SELECT invoices.customer_id, count(invoices.id) AS count_1, sum(invoices.total) AS sum_1, sum(invoices.total - invoices.amount_paid) AS sum_2 
FROM invoices 
WHERE invoices.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID AND invoices.status IN (%(status_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(status_1_2)s::VARCHAR, %(status_1_3)s::VARCHAR) GROUP BY invoices.customer_id

SELECT payments.party_id, sum(payments.amount) AS sum_1 
FROM payments 
WHERE payments.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID AND payments.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR GROUP BY payments.party_id

SELECT payments.party_id, sum(journal_lines.credit - journal_lines.debit) AS sum_1 
FROM payments JOIN journal_entries ON journal_entries.id = payments.journal_id JOIN journal_lines ON journal_lines.journal_id = journal_entries.id JOIN accounts ON accounts.id = journal_lines.account_id 
WHERE payments.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID AND journal_entries.owner_id = %(owner_id_2)s::UUID AND accounts.owner_id = %(owner_id_3)s::UUID AND payments.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND journal_entries.status = %(status_2)s::VARCHAR AND accounts.posting_role = %(posting_role_1)s::VARCHAR GROUP BY payments.party_id

SELECT parties.name, parties.email, parties.phone, parties.address, parties.is_customer, parties.is_supplier, parties.is_active, parties.id, parties.created_at, parties.updated_at, parties.owner_id 
FROM parties 
WHERE parties.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID AND parties.is_customer IS true ORDER BY parties.name, parties.id

SELECT invoices.invoice_number, invoices.customer_id, invoices.issue_date, invoices.due_date, invoices.status, invoices.payment_method, invoices.subtotal, invoices.tax, invoices.total, invoices.amount_paid, invoices.journal_id, invoices.id, invoices.created_at, invoices.updated_at, invoices.owner_id 
FROM invoices 
WHERE invoices.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID

SELECT invoice_items.invoice_id AS invoice_items_invoice_id, invoice_items.product_id AS invoice_items_product_id, invoice_items.description AS invoice_items_description, invoice_items.quantity AS invoice_items_quantity, invoice_items.unit_price AS invoice_items_unit_price, invoice_items.tax AS invoice_items_tax, invoice_items.line_subtotal AS invoice_items_line_subtotal, invoice_items.line_total AS invoice_items_line_total, invoice_items.id AS invoice_items_id 
FROM invoice_items 
WHERE %(param_1)s::UUID = invoice_items.invoice_id

SELECT invoice_checks.invoice_id AS invoice_checks_invoice_id, invoice_checks.amount AS invoice_checks_amount, invoice_checks.sayad_id AS invoice_checks_sayad_id, invoice_checks.due_date AS invoice_checks_due_date, invoice_checks.status AS invoice_checks_status, invoice_checks.cleared_date AS invoice_checks_cleared_date, invoice_checks.cleared_payment_id AS invoice_checks_cleared_payment_id, invoice_checks.id AS invoice_checks_id, invoice_checks.created_at AS invoice_checks_created_at, invoice_checks.updated_at AS invoice_checks_updated_at, invoice_checks.owner_id AS invoice_checks_owner_id 
FROM invoice_checks 
WHERE %(param_1)s::UUID = invoice_checks.invoice_id ORDER BY invoice_checks.due_date, invoice_checks.id

SELECT journal_entries.entry_number, journal_entries.entry_date, journal_entries.description, journal_entries.period_id, journal_entries.status, journal_entries.created_by_id, journal_entries.reversal_of_id, journal_entries.id, journal_entries.created_at, journal_entries.updated_at, journal_entries.owner_id 
FROM journal_entries 
WHERE journal_entries.owner_id = %(owner_id_1)s::UUID

SELECT journal_lines.journal_id AS journal_lines_journal_id, journal_lines.account_id AS journal_lines_account_id, journal_lines.description AS journal_lines_description, journal_lines.debit AS journal_lines_debit, journal_lines.credit AS journal_lines_credit, journal_lines.id AS journal_lines_id 
FROM journal_lines 
WHERE %(param_1)s::UUID = journal_lines.journal_id ORDER BY journal_lines.id
